customer.business: Bonita Style Houston, a modest-fashion boutique (thobes, kaftans, abayas, jalabiyas, bishts)
customer.target: Women in greater Houston, 18 to 55, who dress modestly and buy outfits for Eid, weddings, henna nights, family gatherings and everyday wear
customer.where: Southwest Houston, 8401 Westheimer Rd (Westchase/Sharpstown area), drawing from Sugar Land, Katy, Stafford, Bellaire and Hillcroft

behaviours.name: Occasion shopper
behaviours.how: Buys mainly before Eid, Ramadan and weddings, and wants something new each time.

behaviours.name: TikTok and Instagram discoverer
behaviours.how: Finds clothes through short videos and Lives, and orders from small brands she follows.

behaviours.name: Must try it on
behaviours.how: Has been burned by online sizing and length, so prefers to touch the fabric and try before buying.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Buys abayas cheaply from Amazon, Shein or TikTok Shop and waits for sales.

behaviours.name: Family-abroad buyer
behaviours.how: Gets most pieces from relatives or trips to the Middle East, South Asia or Turkey, where they cost less.

behaviours.name: Loyal to a local shop
behaviours.how: Already has a boutique or mosque-bazaar seller near Hillcroft or Sugar Land she trusts.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Google Maps ratings and comments before trying a new store.

pitch:
Bonita Style, a modest boutique, opens its first store on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 8401 Westheimer Rd, Suite 130, Houston (near Westchase).
Racks of embroidered crepe thobes ($74.99 to $79.99), everyday abayas ($45), kaftans, jalabiya sets ($119.99), bishts ($94.99) and chiffon hijabs ($10).
You can try everything on in the fitting rooms, and staff help with length and sizing.
Opening day only: 15% off everything.
The same brand sells online and on TikTok (about 30,000 followers), so you may have seen its videos.
